item.title: Worker dead after being hit by equipment at construction site in Buckeye
item.description: A worker is dead after being hit by equipment on a construction site in Buckeye on Wednesday afternoon, authorities said.

item.title: Pima County Sheriff Chris Nanos under a microscope as Nancy Guthrie case in its 2nd week
item.description: Pima County Sheriff Chris Nanos admits he isn't used to the amount of scrutiny that has come with leading the investigation into Nancy Guthrie's disappearance.

item.title: Iowa Lakes Community College baseball team bus crashes, killing 1 person and injuring 32
item.description: TWIN LAKES, Iowa (AP) — A community college bus carrying the school’s baseball team crashed and overturned in a ditch in rural Iowa on Wednesday, authorities and media reports said, killing one person and injuring all the other 32 occupants. item.title: BYU standout receiver Parker Kingston charged with first-degree rape in Utah
item.description: Prosecutors in Utah have filed a first-degree felony rape charge against Brigham Young University standout wide receiver Parker Kingston, officials said Wednesday. item.title: Phoenix City Council developing initiative regarding immigration enforcement
